items.title: The Magician
items.short: the will and the skill to start first, without waiting for anyone’s permission

items.title: The High Priestess
items.short: instinct ahead of arguments: reads the situation before anyone explains it

items.title: The Empress
items.short: a generosity that makes warmth around itself and grows living things

items.title: The Emperor
items.short: order and support: holds the structure other people stand on

items.title: The Hierophant
items.short: leaning on knowledge and tradition: explains things until they become clear

items.title: The Lovers
items.short: attraction and choice: draws people close and demands you decide who exactly

items.title: The Chariot
items.short: speed and drive: arrives first, as long as the reins are not dropped

items.title: Strength
items.short: inner power without shouting: copes where others give up

items.title: The Hermit
items.short: depth and the search for meaning: gets to the bottom of things when left alone

items.title: The Wheel
items.short: a sense of timing: luck comes to those who noticed which way it turned

items.title: Justice
items.short: balance and honesty: weighs things and calls them by their names

items.title: The Hanged Man
items.short: a pause and another angle: the one who agreed to wait wins

items.title: Death
items.short: an ending and a renewal: clears away the old to make room

items.title: Temperance
items.short: measure and blending: joins what does not join and keeps an even pace

items.title: The Devil
items.short: passion and matter: gives a powerful pull and the bill for it

items.title: The Tower
items.short: the courage to pull down what was built wrong

items.title: The Star
items.short: inspiration and a landmark: sees the goal before the road appears

items.title: The Moon
items.short: sensitivity and depth: hears the invisible, gets confused by the obvious

items.title: The Sun
items.short: clarity and warmth: with it everything is clearer and easier, including for itself

items.title: Judgement
items.short: a summing-up and a calling: gathers what was done and calls you to do your own

items.title: The World
items.short: wholeness and scale: one room and one role are too small

items.title: The Fool
items.short: freedom and lightness: starts from a blank page as many times as it takes
